definitions.explanation: The year after this one; the coming year. Used to refer to future events or plans in the year that follows the current one.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan next year.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}の{春|はる}に{結婚|けっこん}します。
{来年|らいねん}までに{日本語|にほんご}を{上手|じょうず}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become good at Japanese by next year.

notes: Part of a time reference series: {去年|きょねん} (last year), {今年|ことし} (this year), {来年|らいねん} (next year). The {来|らい} prefix means 'coming' or 'next' and appears in other time words like {来週|らいしゅう} (next week) and {来月|らいげつ} (next month).
